app.title: Battle Navigation
app.tagline: Plan four moves. Out-sail the fleet.

common.biggerShipStronger: A bigger ship is stronger, so match them for an even fight.
common.lootBlurb: Barrels, crates and planks float on the water. End a move on one to take it: cannonballs, tokens or a mended hull.
common.monsterBlurb: Every kind of sea monster joins the battle: a giant squid that never moves but lashes beside and ahead of its bow and surfaces tentacles, a squid and a shark that hunt you down. Sink them, or keep clear.
common.monsterWarningsBlurb: Mark the cells the monster will lash this turn. Off, it strikes without warning, like any ship's plan.

menu.enterNameOnline: Enter a name to play online.
menu.onlineNotSetUp: Online play is not set up for this site.

objectiveBlurb.survive: Stay afloat for {{turns}} turns. If your ship sinks first, you lose.
objectiveBlurb.salvage: A race for floating cargo: the first to take {{target}} wins.
objectiveBlurb.merchant: An unarmed cargo ship runs for the east edge and your opponents escort it. Sink it within {{turns}} turns, or it gets away.
objectiveBlurb.ambush: Raiders close in on you from the start, and more arrive from the corners on later turns. You have a veteran captain’s guns (+1 damage). Sink every raider within {{turns}} turns.

menu.huntBlurb: Hunt the sea monsters for their treasure, with a Kraken at the heart of the sea. Sail out, take what you can and get home.
menu.huntTreasure: Chests float among the monsters, and every monster you sink drops more. Your hold keeps what you take.
menu.huntExit: Sail into the shallows at the south edge, then choose Leave. You bank the whole haul. Sink first and it is lost.
menu.huntBoss: The Kraken rises in the middle of the sea: the biggest hull and the biggest drop. Sinking it is your choice; it does not end the hunt.
menu.quickBlurb: Pick a scenario and sail against the computer.
menu.friendsBlurb: Create a room or join one with a code.
menu.voyageBlurb: A map of battles and ports, with a boss at the end.

easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: Slow to react and easily distracted. A good first voyage.

normal.label: Normal
normal.blurb: Plans ahead and hunts you down, with the odd slip.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: Plays its best plan and keeps out of your line of fire.

calm.label: Calm
calm.blurb: A few rocks and hardly any wind. Mostly open water.

normal.label: Normal
normal.blurb: Reefs, some wind lanes and the odd whirlpool.

stormy.label: Stormy
stormy.blurb: Crowded with reefs, gales and whirlpools. Every board is new.

sloop.name: Sloop
sloop.description: Light and cheap to run, with the smallest token reserve.

brigantine.name: Brigantine
brigantine.description: A sturdier all-rounder with a deeper token reserve.

galleon.name: Galleon
galleon.description: A heavy hull that covers ground fast, but turns less often.

merchantman.name: Merchantman
merchantman.description: An unarmed cargo ship making a run for the edge of the map.

raider.name: Raider
raider.description: A light pirate sloop sent to ambush you.

private.label: Private
private.blurb: Not listed. Only people you give the room key to can join.

public.label: Public
public.blurb: Listed for everyone, who can join with one click.

legend.windText: pushes a ship one cell, each phase it ends on a wind cell.
legend.whirlpoolText: carries a ship round its four cells and turns it a quarter, every phase it ends in one.
legend.lootText: is taken by the ship that ends a phase on it: barrels give cannonballs, chests give tokens, planks mend the hull.

voyage.introBlurb: Sail a Sloop across five seas. Win battles, mend your ship at ports and grow it with upgrades. Lose a battle and the voyage is over.
voyage.abandonBody: Your ship and everything you have earned will be lost.
voyage.rewardHunt: Reward: plunder +{{count}}, and more for the treasure you bring out ({{per}} treasure is one plunder), and +{{boss}} for the Kraken.
voyage.bossBlurb: A flagship guards these waters. Sink it to sail on.
voyage.huntBlurb: Sea monsters and a Kraken, and treasure for whoever takes it. Leave through the shallows when you choose.
voyage.huntAgainst: The sea monsters, and the Kraken
voyage.victoryBody: You beat the last boss and crossed every sea.
voyage.eventHuntWon: You left with {{haul}} in treasure. Plunder: +{{count}}.
voyage.eventKrakenSlain: The Kraken is slain: a bonus in plunder.

reinforceHull.name: Reinforce the hull
reinforceHull.blurb: +1 maximum hull and mend 1. A big enough hull refits your ship as a larger class.

cannonballs.blurb: +2 cannonballs now, and in every restock.
